lesson.intro: El ingles no tiene un unico "tiempo futuro": elige la forma segun como ves ese futuro. will = decision en el momento, promesa o prediccion-opinion. be going to = plan ya decidido o prediccion con evidencia. presente continuo = cita o arreglo con hora fijada. presente simple = horario o calendario oficial. Y tras when / if / as soon as... nunca se usa will.

sections.heading: 1 - will: forma
sections.body:
will + verbo base, igual para todas las personas. No lleva -s ni to.

Contraccion: 'll (I'll, she'll, we'll...). Negativa: won't (= will not). Pregunta: Will + sujeto + base.

shall se usa hoy sobre todo en Shall I...? / Shall we...? para ofrecer ayuda o hacer una sugerencia.

sections.heading: 2 - will: uso
sections.body:
• Predicciones y opiniones, sobre todo con I think, I believe, I expect, probably, perhaps, I'm sure.
  • Decisiones espontaneas, tomadas en el momento de hablar.
  • Promesas y ofrecimientos.
  • Hechos futuros seguros: She'll be 30 next month.
examples: The phone's ringing - I'll get it.
That's heavy - I'll carry it for you.

sections.heading: 3 - be going to: forma
sections.body:
am / is / are + going to + verbo base.

Negativa: 'm not / isn't / aren't going to. Pregunta: Am / Is / Are + sujeto + going to + base.

En ingles hablado informal se oye gonna (no se escribe en textos formales).
examples: I'm going to rest this weekend.

sections.heading: 4 - be going to: uso
sections.body:
• Planes e intenciones que ya habias decidido antes de hablar.
  • Predicciones con evidencia que ves ahora mismo (nubes negras, alguien que tropieza...).

Para preguntar por planes: What are you going to do...?
examples: We're going to paint the kitchen this weekend.
I've decided - I'm going to quit my job.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
Watch out, you're going to fall!

sections.heading: 5 - will vs going to
sections.body:
Decision: en el momento → will; ya pensada de antes → be going to.

Prediccion: opinion sin pruebas → will; con evidencia visible ahora → be going to.

Muchas veces las dos son posibles; la diferencia esta en si ya lo habias planeado.
examples: A: We need bread. B: I'll buy some. (decido ahora)
I'm going to buy bread later. (ya lo pensaba)

sections.heading: 6 - Present Continuous para el futuro
sections.body:
Citas y arreglos ya fijados, casi siempre con otras personas y con hora o dia concretos (tomorrow, tonight, at 6, on Friday, next week).

Muy comun con verbos de movimiento y encuentros: meet, see, go, come, leave, fly, play, have (dinner).
examples: We're flying to Rome on Monday.

sections.heading: 7 - Present Simple para el futuro
sections.body:
Solo para horarios y calendarios oficiales: transportes, cine, clases, programas de eventos. Suele haber una hora o fecha establecida.

Verbos tipicos: start, finish, begin, end, open, close, leave, arrive, depart, be (Tomorrow is Monday).

sections.heading: 8 - Futuro en subordinadas de tiempo y condicion
sections.body: Tras when, after, before, as soon as, until, if (condicional tipo 1) no se usa will: el verbo va en presente simple aunque el sentido sea futuro. El will va en la oracion principal.
examples: As soon as the taxi comes, we'll go.

contrast.title: Que forma para el futuro?
rows: Tras when / if / as soon as...

mistakes: NO: I will to help you. -> SI: I will help you.
NO: She will comes tomorrow. -> SI: She will come tomorrow.
NO: (suena el telefono y decides) I'm going to answer it. -> SI: I'll answer it.
NO: Look at the sky! It will rain. -> SI: It's going to rain.
NO: I'll call you when I will arrive. -> SI: ... when I arrive.
NO: What do you do tonight? (plan) -> SI: What are you doing tonight?
NO: The train will leave at 6. (horario) -> SI: The train leaves at 6.

sources.label: British Council LearnEnglish - Talking about the future
British Council LearnEnglish - be going to
Test-English - Future: will, be going to, present continuous (B1)

questions.prompt: I ___ help you.
She ___ be here soon.
They ___ come tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Negativa de will = won't (= will not).

questions.prompt: ___ you open the window, please?
Completa: He ___ (call) you back.
'I'll' es la contraccion de:
We ___ not forget this day.
___ it rain later, do you think?
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre el futuro: Will + it + base.

questions.prompt: El verbo despues de 'will' va en:
Cual es correcta?
options: She will to arrive at six.

questions.prompt: Completa: They ___ (not / be) late.
___ I carry that for you? (ofrecimiento)
I think it ___ be sunny tomorrow.
The phone's ringing. - OK, I ___ answer it.
questions.explanation: Decision espontanea en el momento -> will.

questions.prompt: I promise I ___ pay you back.
That bag looks heavy. I ___ carry it for you.
The sun ___ rise at 6:12 tomorrow.
In 2050, robots ___ probably do this job.
Don't worry, everything ___ be fine.
Maybe I ___ go to the party, maybe not.
questions.explanation: Decision aun no tomada, con 'maybe' -> will.

questions.prompt: - It's cold in here. - I ___ close the window.
Where's the ketchup? - I ___ get it.
I'm sure you ___ pass the exam.
questions.explanation: Prediccion basada en opinion / animo -> will.

questions.prompt: She ___ be 30 next month.
'Perhaps', 'probably', 'I expect', 'I think' suelen ir con:
questions.explanation: Esos marcadores de prediccion piden will.

questions.prompt: Completa: I ___ (going to + visit) my aunt.
She ___ going to study law.
They ___ going to move house.
We ___ going to be late. (negativa)
___ you going to eat that?
Completa: He ___ (going to + not + come).
Despues de 'going to' usamos:
Cual es correcta?
___ it going to rain?
Completa: We ___ (going to + have) a party.
'gonna' es la forma hablada informal de:
What ___ they going to do about it?
We ___ paint the kitchen this weekend. (ya decidido)
questions.explanation: Plan decidido de antemano -> be going to.

questions.prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.explanation: Prediccion con evidencia visible -> be going to.

questions.prompt: I've decided: I ___ learn to drive this year.
questions.explanation: Intencion ya tomada -> be going to.

questions.prompt: He's driving too fast. He ___ crash!
questions.explanation: Evidencia clara ahora -> be going to.

questions.prompt: She ___ have a baby in June.
questions.explanation: Situacion ya en marcha / plan -> be going to.

questions.prompt: Careful! You ___ drop it.
Our plans for the summer: we ___ travel around Asia.
The sky is completely black. There ___ be a storm.
questions.explanation: Prediccion con evidencia -> be going to.

questions.prompt: What ___ you ___ do when you finish university?
questions.explanation: Preguntar por planes / intenciones -> be going to.

questions.prompt: I ___ start a diet on Monday. (ya decidido)
He isn't ready. He ___ miss the train.
'be going to' NO suele usarse para:
questions.explanation: Para decidir en el instante se usa will.

questions.prompt: They ___ get married next spring. (ya lo planean)
- We've run out of milk. - Oh, I ___ buy some.
questions.explanation: Decision tomada al oir la noticia -> will.

questions.prompt: A: Why is the oven on? B: I ___ bake a cake. (ya lo tenia pensado)
I think our team ___ win. (opinion, sin pruebas)
It's 5-0. Our team ___ win! (evidencia)
questions.explanation: Prediccion con evidencia -> be going to.

questions.prompt: The doorbell rang. - I ___ get it!
Have you decided about the job? - Yes, I ___ accept it.
questions.explanation: Decision ya tomada -> be going to.

questions.prompt: Perhaps it ___ snow tonight.
Look how pale he is. He ___ faint.
That's the phone. - Don't move, I ___ answer it.
We ___ spend Christmas with my parents this year. (plan familiar)
I've made up my mind. I ___ tell him the truth.
questions.explanation: Decision ya tomada -> be going to.

questions.prompt: This box is too heavy for you. - Don't worry, I ___ help you.
Regla rapida: decision tomada en este instante ->
questions.explanation: Decision espontanea -> will; plan previo -> be going to.

questions.prompt: I ___ Ana for coffee tomorrow. (cita acordada)
questions.explanation: Arreglo fijado con otra persona -> presente continuo.

questions.prompt: We ___ to the theatre on Friday. (entradas compradas)
questions.explanation: Plan concreto con fecha -> presente continuo.

questions.prompt: What ___ you ___ tonight?
questions.explanation: Preguntar por planes concretos -> presente continuo.

questions.prompt: She ___ the 7:00 flight tomorrow. (reservado por ella)
He ___ his parents this weekend. (planeado)
I can't come on Saturday - I ___ my brother from the airport.
El presente continuo para el futuro necesita:
options: un momento futuro y un arreglo ya fijado
questions.answer: un momento futuro y un arreglo ya fijado

questions.prompt: They ___ next month. (fecha de boda fijada)
___ you ___ anything special for your birthday?
I ___ at 6 a.m., so I need to sleep early. (vuelo reservado)
questions.explanation: Arreglo personal con hora -> presente continuo.

questions.prompt: We ___ dinner with the Smiths on Thursday.
Sorry, I ___ tennis with Sam at 5. (quedada)
questions.explanation: Arreglo con otra persona y hora -> presente continuo.

questions.prompt: The train ___ at 9:15. (horario)
The film ___ at 8 p.m. tonight. (cartelera)
Our English class ___ on Monday. (calendario)
What time ___ the museum ___ tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Horario oficial -> presente simple: does + open.

questions.prompt: According to the schedule, the next bus ___ at 10:40.
El presente simple para el futuro es para:
The conference ___ next Tuesday and ___ on Thursday. (programa)
My flight ___ at 06:30 - check-in two hours before.
questions.explanation: Horario oficial del vuelo -> presente simple.

questions.prompt: The shops ___ at 8 on Sundays. (horario habitual)
Tomorrow ___ Friday.
The match ___ at 20:00. (programacion)
When ___ the semester ___? (calendario academico)
I'll call you when I ___ home.
questions.explanation: Tras 'when' con sentido futuro -> presente simple (sin will).

questions.prompt: We'll start as soon as everyone ___ here.
If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay in.
Wait here until I ___ back.
After you ___ this, you'll understand.
Before she ___, she'll pack her bags.
I won't leave until you ___ me the truth.
He'll be angry when he ___ out.
En 'I'll help you when you need it', el verbo tras 'when' va en:
questions.explanation: Regla: no se usa will tras when/if/as soon as...

questions.prompt: As soon as the taxi ___, we'll go.
If you ___ hard, you'll pass.
We'll have dinner after the guests ___.
Cual es correcta?
options: When I see her, I'll tell her.
When I will see her, I'll tell her.
When I'll see her, I tell her.
questions.answer: When I see her, I'll tell her.
questions.explanation: 'when' + presente simple; will solo en la principal.
